turns.playerInput: > You ask the innkeeper who the woman with the coin is.
turns.modelOutput: "Mira Vale," the innkeeper says. "Passing through, same as you."

turns.label: T5 first interaction with the activated NPC
turns.playerInput: > You cross the room and ask Mira Vale if the northern road is still open.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale looks up. The coin stops on her knuckle. "Open," she says, "if you don't mind the drifts. I came down it this morning." She studies you a moment longer than politeness requires.

turns.label: T6 continued interaction
turns.playerInput: > You sit down across from her and tell her your name.
turns.modelOutput: "Azure," Mira Vale repeats, as if filing it somewhere. "Mira." She does not offer a hand, but she does not move away either. "You're going north, then. Alone?"

turns.label: T7 relationship-relevant beat
turns.playerInput: > You admit you are travelling alone and ask if she would consider going together.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale is quiet for a while. "I don't travel with people I don't know," she says, then, after a pause, "but I'd share a road for a day and see." It is not trust. It is the shape trust would take, if it came.

turns.label: T8 quiet turn
turns.playerInput: > You agree, and order two bowls of stew.
turns.modelOutput: The stew arrives steaming. Mira Vale eats without ceremony, watching the door out of habit.

turns.modelOutput: She traces the road on the table with one finger.
